mapper.sql: select t.team_id, t.team_name, t.team_key, t.team_icon, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, t.introduce, t.is_del, t.is_lock, t.lock_remark, t.defect_builtin_field_config, t.defect_page_config, t.module_page_config, t.case_review_template, t.plan_id, pl.plan_name, IFNULL(p.project_count, 0) as project_count, IFNULL(m.member_count, 0) as member_count from sys_team t LEFT JOIN sys_team_plan pl ON pl.plan_id = t.plan_id LEFT JOIN ( select count(team_id) as project_count, team_id from sys_project group by team_id ) p ON p.team_id = t.team_id LEFT JOIN ( select count(team_id) as member_count, team_id from sys_user_team where team_lock = 0 group by team_id ) m ON m.team_id = t.team_id
